scope: All three straight phases and one setting; no post-outcome phase/threshold/window/horizon selection. A pass is an experimental screen, not global stability or automatic adoption.

metric_denominators.traversal: All physical states from3s through first reference-arrival state; includes pauses. Exact distance to shared finite1.2mstraightsegment.
metric_denominators.progress_weighted: Trapezoidal integral(error^2 du) over complete referenceu0to1. Never grades partial path successful; paused intervals havezero progress weight and remain in timeRMS/peak/stall metrics.
metric_denominators.primary_episode: First referencearrival+10s goalhold, not arbitrary later tail. Actualgoal convergence requires final2s≤20mm and≤.02m/s.
metric_denominators.current_target: Each arm's unchanged native observer-normal attitude target. Absolute tilt reported separately; no frozen-native-target substitution after physical paths differ.
metric_denominators.commands: Held intervals only, excluding primary episode end/actualterminal emittedcommand. Fractions and absoluteclippedseconds bothgated.
metric_denominators.original_schedule: Original35s patharrival/45s episode timing remains descriptive schedulelag; not primarypathtracking gate.
